name: Operation: Southern Comfort
effect: HANDLER: Deep South is calling, agent. Plate 3 dishes that each use a Southern ingredient (oysters or milkfish). Try not to get sauce on the dossier.
art_note: Stamp reading SOUTH over a Tainan oyster-flat motif

name: Operation: Northern Exposure
effect: HANDLER: Work the capital. Plate 3 dishes that each use a Northern ingredient (beef or pork). Beef noodle counts. Beef noodle always counts.
art_note: Stamp reading NORTH over a Taipei skyline motif

name: Operation: High Country
effect: HANDLER: Head for the tea hills. Plate 3 dishes that each use a Central ingredient (tea or tapioca pearls). Stay caffeinated.
art_note: Stamp reading CENTRAL over rolling Nantou tea terraces

name: Operation: Rift Valley
effect: HANDLER: The East coast is worth the ride. Plate 3 dishes that each use an Eastern ingredient (mountain rice or wild greens).
art_note: Stamp reading EAST over the Hualien coastline

name: Operation: Round the Island
effect: HANDLER: The classic lap. Across your plated dishes, use at least one ingredient sourced from ALL FOUR regions. The full grand tour.
art_note: Passport spread with four regional stamps

name: Operation: The Full Sampler
effect: HANDLER: Breadth over depth. Your plated dishes must together feature 5 different specialty ingredients. A little of everything.
art_note: Tasting flight of five little plates

name: Operation: Beef & Bao
effect: HANDLER: Two Taipei icons, one trip. Plate Beef Noodle Soup 牛肉麵 AND Gua Bao 割包.
art_note: Two dossier photos clipped together — a bowl and a bao

name: Operation: Sweet & Salty
effect: HANDLER: A study in contrasts. Plate Bubble Tea 珍珠奶茶 AND Oyster Omelette 蚵仔煎. Order doesn't matter; taste does.
art_note: Split photo — boba on one side

name: Operation: Tea Ceremony
effect: HANDLER: All roads lead to tea. Plate Bubble Tea 珍珠奶茶 AND Tea Egg 茶葉蛋.
art_note: A steaming cup beside a marbled tea egg

name: Operation: Chef's Table
effect: HANDLER: You're going for glory. Plate any 2 Signature dishes (the 5-VP feasts). Ambitious. We like it.

name: Operation: One Grand Feast
effect: HANDLER: Land one showpiece. Plate any 1 Signature dish (辦桌 / 環島大餐 / 團圓飯).

name: Operation: Big Appetite
effect: HANDLER: Go big. Plate 2 dishes of 3 ingredients or more (any 4- or 5-VP dish). Loosen the belt.

name: Operation: Night Owl
effect: HANDLER: Just keep eating. Plate 5 dishes in total. The market doesn't close and neither do you.
art_note: Neon night-market stamp with a wide-awake owl

name: Operation: Marathon Eater
effect: HANDLER: Iron stomach protocol. Plate 6 dishes in total. Pace yourself; there's no medal, only points.
art_note: Finish-line ribbon over a stack of empty bowls

name: Operation: Balanced Diet
effect: HANDLER: Eat the whole island. Plate at least one dish from each region (a Northern, Central, Southern AND Eastern dish).
